# NYC Mafia × D&D — Trash / salvage archive

**What this is:** Superseded drafts, pre-reskin reports, and void-era worldbuilding kept for **salvage only**. Not Docs SoT and not play canon.

**Do not edit as canon.** If an idea is worth keeping, promote it into active SoT (`LOCKS.md`, `SETTING-*.md`, `reports/2026-08-01-*.md`, `worldbuilding/details/`) and note the source path here or in `worldbuilding/SALVAGE-NOTES.md`.

## Layout

| Path | Contents |
|------|----------|
| `reports/` | Dated reports from 2026-06/07 and legacy 2026-08-04/05 (1931 / 1999 voice) |
| `setting/` | `SETTING-PROHIBITION-MAGIC.md`, `SETTING-MAGITECH-DIVERGENCE.md` (void thesis) |
| `worldbuilding/` | `era-law-pack` stroke/details/vignettes, `legacy-reskin/` batch |

Session play stubs live in **`reports/_session/`** (also excluded from Hub Docs index).

**Active index:** `reports/README.md`
